::: {#sol-decode-connectives}

- $P \land Q$ is true only in the first row, where $P$ and $Q$ are both true.
  It reads "$P$ and $Q$".
- $P \lor Q$ is false only in the last row, where $P$ and $Q$ are both false,
  so it is true when at least one of them is true.
  It reads "$P$ or $Q$".
  It is true in the first row too, where both are true.
- $\neg P$ has the opposite truth value to $P$.
  It reads "not $P$".

:::
